steps.title: Permeabilize sections
steps.instruction: Store free‑floating brain sections in PBS with 0.02 % sodium azide, then transfer to fresh PBS containing 1 % Triton X‑100 and incubate 1 hour at room temperature to permeabilize the tissue.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Prepare blocking solution of 10 % normal donkey serum in PBS with 0.3 % Triton X‑100 (PBST) and incubate the sections in this buffer for 90 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Make primary antibody solution in PBST containing 1 % normal donkey serum, place sections in the solution, and incubate overnight at 4 °C with gentle agitation.

steps.title: Wash after primary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the sections three times in PBS, each wash lasting 10 minutes, to remove unbound primary antibody.

steps.title: Incubate with secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute fluorophore‑conjugated secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor series) 1:500 in PBST with 1 % normal donkey serum, incubate sections for 90 minutes at room temperature protected from light.

steps.title: Wash after secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the sections three times in PBS, each wash lasting 10 minutes, to remove excess secondary antibody.

steps.title: Mount and coverslip
steps.instruction: Mount the stained sections onto clean glass microscope slides, air‑dry overnight in the dark, then apply coverslips using ProLong™ Diamond Antifade Mountant.
